title: GCP service accounts in a project
description: Lists IAM service accounts in one project with email, display name and disabled state.

outputs.name: disabled
outputs.description: True when the account is disabled

cost.notes: One list call per project when swept org-wide

template: SELECT email, displayName, disabled, uniqueId FROM google.iam.service_accounts WHERE projectsId = '{{project}}';
notes: For key hygiene, follow up per account with google.iam.service_accounts_keys filtered by the account email to find user-managed keys and their ages.
